born.why: This code prioritizes survival by eating when starving, distinguishes clearly safe vs poisonous fruits using historical data, uses 'taste' to resolve ambiguous mixed histories when not starving, and seeks out potentially good foods or any food when hungry.

The code prioritizes eating known-safe fruits and tasting unknown/risky ones to build experience, while avoiding fruits with a strong history of harm unless starving, thus balancing data collection with survival.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starvation is imminent, avoids confirmed poisons, uses 'taste' for safe exploration of new fruits, and seeks fruits with positive safety records to maximize long-term energy gain.

The code prioritizes avoiding known poison and reduces unnecessary tasting of confirmed safe species by eating them directly when abundant, while using hunger thresholds to decide whether to explore unknown fruits or play it safe.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding poison when possible, but uses 'carry' for known-safe fruits to optimize energy expenditure and ensures she tastes unknown fruits only if hunger warrants it, balancing exploration with safety.

The code prioritizes starvation safety, then uses species identity for immediate decisions, and finally leverages trait-based similarity (color/shape) to safely explore new fruits by predicting safety from known safe relatives, reducing the need for risky blind trials.

The code prioritizes survival by eating unknowns at higher hunger thresholds (85%) and known safe foods immediately, while avoiding known poisons and tasting unknowns only when safe to do so (felt < 70%), balancing exploration with starvation risk.
